report.summary: The only failure is test_invalid_book_is_rejected[blank-title]: POST /api/books with a whitespace-only title ('   ') returns 201 instead of 422. The cause is in the app: validate_book checks `if not book.title` (app/main.py:75), which does not reject whitespace, while the author check on line 77 uses `.strip()`. Fix validate_book to strip the title before checking it.

causes.title: Whitespace-only book title is accepted by the API
causes.explanation: validate_book only rejects an empty title, because `not book.title` is False for a non-empty string such as '   '. The author check on the next line uses `book.author.strip()`, so the title check is inconsistent with it. The request therefore passes validation, insert_book stores the row, and the endpoint returns 201. The test expects 422 with 'Title must not be blank', which is the correct behavior, so the test is right to fail. This is deterministic, not timing-related.
evidence: tests/api/test_books_api.py:66: assert response.status_code == 422 failed with 'assert 201 == 422' (test parameter book={'title': '   ', 'author': 'A'})
app/main.py:75: `if not book.title:` does not catch whitespace-only strings
app/main.py:77: `if not book.author.strip():` shows the intended pattern for blank checks
app/main.py:153-154: insert_book calls validate_book(book) before inserting, so the bad title is stored
app/main.py:199-201: POST /api/books has status_code=201 and returns insert_book's result with no other check
causes.suggested_fix: In app/main.py validate_book, change line 75 to `if not book.title.strip():`. Consider also stripping stored titles, and check that PUT /api/books/{book_id} (which also goes through BookIn) gets the same validation. Then add a UI or API test for a whitespace-only title if one is missing.
